Who we are

Young people. One faith. One community.

MFC Youth Chapter 7 is a space where young people can encounter Christ, build genuine friendships, and take part in a community that encourages one another to keep growing in faith.

From chapter gatherings to simple moments together, every experience becomes part of the journey — learning, serving, laughing, praying, and showing up for each other.

“Rooted in Christ, growing in community, and sent to make a difference.”
